changelog:
Initial release of simple-claude-deep-research-agent.

- Added comprehensive documentation (SKILL.md) covering creation, management, and sharing of Agent Skills in Claude Code.
- Describes requirements for skill structure, YAML frontmatter, and best practices for effective discovery/use.
- Includes detailed sections on adding support files, limiting tool access, troubleshooting, and versioning.
- Outlines processes for personal, project, and plugin-based skills, as well as collaboration workflows.
- Provides practical debugging tips, real-world workflow examples, and guidance for maximizing team productivity.
summary: Perform deep research using Claude by autonomously gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing detailed information across diverse topics on request.
